Definition: A list of ready-made items, such as cubes, lights, tiles and models, that you can add to a scene.
A tree of everything in the open scene: its layers, cameras and items.
The panel on the right of the scene editor that shows, and lets you change, the selected item's properties.
Lines drawn in the editor, spaced evenly, to help you place items. They don't show up in your game.
The space between two grid lines: 32 pixels in 2D and 1 meter in 3D, unless you change it.
A number that gives a position along one direction. In 2D there are two, x and y; in 3D there are three, x, y and z.
What a scene is seen through. It has a position and a direction it looks in.
A set of 3D models made to fit together, such as roads, castle walls or trees, that shows up as one group in the palette.
In the terrain editor, the circle on the ground that a terrain tool changes.
